headline: The job is done. The numbers are still on the ute.
Friday's hours are on a scrap of paper. The photos are in someone's phone. The invoice is waiting.
You can't bill what nobody told you about. So you ring the crew and wait.

eyebrow: The cost of lost field data
headline: Every missing hour or material is work you did and can't prove.
Hours, materials and photos go onto the job from the site. Nothing rides home on a scrap of paper.
The office sees the job as it happens. No phone calls to piece it together.
Same day on site. Different trip back to the office.
before: Details rebuilt from memory, texts and scraps of paper.
after: Hours, materials and photos already on the job.

headline: Deliver the job. Keep every detail.
